title: Website clarity via scenario-based differentiation
description: Strengthen DaemonCore’s public positioning by adding clear, IP-safe scenario comparisons that demonstrate the difference a governance layer makes, and by enforcing deliberate, intentional layout discipline across the site.
success_criteria: Visitors can clearly articulate the difference between running agents with and without DaemonCore.
Scenario comparisons focus on outcomes and constraints, not implementation details.
No content exposes internal mechanisms or patent-sensitive information.
All multi-card sections render with intentional layouts and no accidental wrapping.
notes: This epic is deliberately outcome-focused. It exists to make the category break obvious without explaining how DaemonCore works internally.
